proposal_set.name: aiter-attention-on
proposal_set.reason: Every MI300X/MI325X/MI355X reference launcher selects AITER attention explicitly rather than the framework default. Decode dominates at ISL=OSL=1024/conc=64 on a dense GQA model, so the attention kernel is the hot path. vLLM has no --attention-backend aiter CLI flag; the equivalent is the ROCm AITER env gate, and the master gate plus the MHA gate are coupled (MHA path is a no-op unless the master gate is on), hence atomic. Ranked first: it is the only prior with a direct AMD-authored recommendation touching the measured hot path.

proposal_set.name: sched-overhead-trim
proposal_set.reason: vLLM re-expression of the reference recipe's fixed-seq-len scheduling block. At a fixed 1024-token ISL with no shared prefix, prefix caching only buys per-step hash/lookup cost; pinning the cudagraph capture set to the benchmark concurrency removes ladder mismatch and capture memory. Coupled: dropping prefix caching changes the block-manager path that the cudagraph sizes are captured against, so they must be benched together. Ranked second - pure CPU/step overhead, typically low-single-digit % on an 8B dense model, so nearer the 1.00% KEEP bar than proposal 1.

proposal_set.name: aiter-attention-stack
proposal_set.reason: Rank 1. Every MI300X/MI325X/MI355X reference script selects the AITER attention backend explicitly rather than the framework default; the Qwen3.5 MI300X entry is an AMD-authored recipe. Decode dominates at ISL=OSL=1024/conc64 on a dense GQA model, so attention kernel choice is the largest remaining lever once MoE/MTP are ruled out. Atomic because VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER is the master gate — VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA is inert without it. Verdict: worth_a_bench, route=config (no patch; env-only). Could NOT be verified as already_present: sandbox denies reads of the installed vllm tree, so if the build already defaults AITER on, this benches as a no-op rather than a regression.

proposal_set.name: fixed-seqlen-scheduler-overhead
proposal_set.reason: Rank 2. vLLM re-expression of the reference recipe's fixed-seq-len scheduling block (--disable-radix-cache, --max-prefill-tokens 32768, --cuda-graph-max-bs = concurrency). At a fixed ISL with no shared prefixes the prefix cache only costs per-step hashing and lookup; pinning the cudagraph capture set to the actual concurrency (64) removes ladder mismatch and recapture. Atomic: the three flags are one coherent fixed-seq-len scheduling regime — pinning cuda-graph-sizes to 64 alone, while the prefix cache still perturbs batch composition, gives up most of the effect. --scheduler-recv-interval has no vLLM analogue and is deliberately omitted. Verdict: worth_a_bench, route=config. Accuracy risk none (scheduling only).
